# EkGuru

> Online Hindi tutoring. Verified native Hindi tutors from India teach one-to-one
> live lessons to students worldwide, from $3 per lesson.
> Founded by Prakash — MNIT Jaipur, CSE 2022–2026 batch pass out.

EkGuru is a Hindi-only tutoring platform. Every tutor listed teaches Hindi and nothing
else. Students contact tutors directly; EkGuru takes no commission. Lessons cover
speaking, listening, grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation and the Devanagari script,
for beginner through advanced learners.

## Tutors

- [Sushila G.](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/tutor/sushila-g/): Friendly Hindi Tutor — Speak, Read & Write with Confidence. $3 per 50 min. Teaches Hindi for beginners, Conversational Hindi, Hindi grammar, Devanagari reading & writing, Hindi for kids, Pronunciation training. Levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced. Based in Rajasthan, India, timezone IST (GMT+5:30). Rated 5/5 from 3 reviews. Intro video: https://youtu.be/Ykic7gkyHjg
- [Hemlata](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/tutor/hemlata/): Native Hindi Tutor for Kids, Adults & Beginners — Read, Write & Speak. $12 per 50 min. Teaches Hindi for beginners, Hindi for kids, Conversational Hindi, Devanagari reading & writing, Hindi grammar, Pronunciation training. Levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced. Based in India, timezone IST (GMT+5:30).
- [Tara](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/tutor/tara/): Native Hindi Tutor — Conversation, Grammar & Script for Every Level. $8 per 50 min. Teaches Conversational Hindi, Hindi for beginners, Hindi grammar, Devanagari reading & writing. Levels: Beginner, Intermediate. Based in India, timezone IST (GMT+5:30).

## Pages

- [Home](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/): overview, how it works, frequently asked questions
- [Find Tutors](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/find-tutors.html): search and filter by level, price and rating
- [Become a Tutor](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/join.html): free listing for Hindi teachers, no commission
- [Tutor directory](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/tutor/): plain text listing of every tutor

## Languages

The site is available in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese and
Arabic. Translated pages: [Español](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/es/), [Français](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/fr/), [Deutsch](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/de/), [Português](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/pt/), [日本語](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/ja/), [العربية](https://ekgurulearning.github.io/EkGuru/ar/)

## Facts

- Languages taught: Hindi only
- Lesson format: live one-to-one video call, 50 min typical
- Price range: $3 to $12 per lesson
- Currency: shown automatically in the visitor's local currency, charged in USD
- Trial lessons: available with 3 of 3 tutors
- Booking: by email or WhatsApp directly with the tutor, no account needed
- Contact: EkGuruLearning@gmail.com
